meta.name: Taking New York
meta.description: A reality series that follows the lives and loves of a group of British twenty-somethings as they battle to build their American Dream life in The Big Apple.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Megan shows up in New York to surprise her twin sister Amy and then male models Jamie and Ben try it on with the newly reunited sisters. Georgina is fired from her concierge job and turns to bar owner Gagan to keep her visa and her New York dream alive.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Despite the awkward moment at Jamie's birthday drinks, gallery director Amy still wants to spend more time with him. Her best mate James advises her to play it cool; however, she can't stay away.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Sumner and Georgina become friends and Sophie is left out in the cold. After Sumner and Sophie eventually meet up they agree to try and sort things out by healing Sophie's relationship with Georgina, but things end up taking a surprising twist. Georgina enjoys a first date with Ben and they share a kiss before he makes her an offer she is unable to refuse.
